title: M/s Shri Balaji Enterprises & Anr. v. State of U.P. & Ors.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Surya Prakash Kesarwani, J.; Surendra Singh-I, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; petitioner relegated to Para 6.14 instalment remedy.
headnote: A consumer seeking additional time to pay outstanding electricity dues and unsealing of premises must avail Paragraph 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Allahabad High Court dismissed the mandamus petition, leaving that instalment remedy open.
facts: M/s Shri Balaji Enterprises and another filed a writ petition seeking a mandamus directing the respondents to grant additional time to pay outstanding dues and to unseal their premises. Counsel for respondent No. 5, the distribution licensee, stated that the petitioners had a remedy under Paragraph 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Division Bench heard counsel for the petitioners, the State, and the licensee, and decided the petition on that objection without examining the demand or sealing on merits.

holding_units.holding: A writ of mandamus seeking additional time to pay outstanding electricity dues and unsealing of the consumer's premises does not lie where Paragraph 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 affords the instalment remedy; the petition is dismissed leaving that Code remedy open.

principle_tags.application: The Court treated Paragraph 6.14 as the proper Code remedy for a consumer seeking additional time to pay outstanding dues, and dismissed the writ leaving that instalment clause to be availed.
The prayer for extra time to pay outstanding dues and to unseal the premises was treated as a Paragraph 6.14 instalment-facility matter, not a subject for writ mandamus.

not_decided.point: Whether instalments or additional time should be granted under Paragraph 6.14
not_decided.note: Left open to the petitioner to avail the Code remedy.

not_decided.point: Whether the premises should be unsealed
